mapper.select: SELECT id, latitude, longitude, ( 6371000 * 2 * ASIN( SQRT( POWER(SIN(RADIANS(latitude - #{latitude}) / 2), 2) + COS(RADIANS(#{latitude})) * COS(RADIANS(latitude)) * POWER(SIN(RADIANS(longitude - #{longitude}) / 2), 2) ) ) ) AS distance FROM location HAVING distance <= 100 ORDER BY distance asc limit 1;
